methods.name: FedSeIT
methods.description: A method in FCL setup where alignment and relevance of foreign tasks parameters at each client minimise inter-client interference and improve inter-client transfer learning without dense-layer-sharing

methods.name: FedWeIT
methods.description: Baseline model performing weighted additive filter composition.

methods.name: Fed-SeIT+DLS
methods.description: Baseline or ablation variant evaluated against FedSeIT

methods.name: Federated Selective Inter-client Transfer (FedSeIT)
methods.description: A framework designed to minimize inter-client interference and communication cost while maximizing inter-client knowledge transfer in federated continual learning by decomposing each client's model parameters into dense local base parameters, sparse task-adaptive parameters, and sparse mask parameters.

methods.name: SIT
methods.description: Mechanism for selecting relevant foreign parameters from historical tasks of foreign clients

methods.name: dense-layer-sharing (DLS)
methods.description: Application of sharing dense layers across clients in FedSeIT

methods.name: Additive parameter decomposition
methods.description: Decomposes client model parameters into base parameters masked for selective global knowledge utilization and task-adaptive parameters capturing task-specific knowledge.

methods.name: Server parameter aggregation
methods.description: Accumulates task-generic global knowledge across clients by aggregating local base parameters sent from all clients.
